Title: Scope
Prompt: Write the scope as included and excluded. Use only the notes. Put unknowns under questions.

Title: Price block
Prompt: Write the price section using the number, currency, and what it includes. Do not add a discount.
Check: The number is the one I typed.

Title: Timeline
Use when: You have a start and an end.
Prompt: Write the timeline with those dates and the dependency I named. Do not promise a date I did not give.

Title: Assumptions
Prompt: List assumptions from my notes. If an assumption is broken, say the price is revisited. Do not invent a penalty.

Title: Plain summary
Prompt: Write a 120-word summary a buyer can forward. No adjectives about our passion.
Check: It can be forwarded as-is after you check it.

Title: Redline
Prompt: Compare their edits to my original scope and list what changed the work. Do not accept the change for me.
